title: Work-Hours & Pay Guides | Elmtrackr
og_title: Guides to tracking work hours and estimating pay
description: Practical guides to tracking work hours, estimating hourly pay, understanding overtime and premiums, and reviewing your hours against a payslip.
lead: These guides answer the everyday questions hourly and shift workers ask about their time and pay — how to keep an accurate record, how pay is estimated, and how to check it. They explain the ideas in plain terms, then show where a tool like Elmtrackr fits and where it does not.

blocks.p: What to write down for each shift, and how to avoid forgotten entries.
How an hourly rate, paid time, overtime and premiums add up to an estimate — and why it is only an estimate.
The difference between extra pay for extra hours and extra pay for when you work.

ul: Overtime vs premium pay: what's the difference?

blocks.p: How to compare your own record with a payslip and raise a question when something looks off.

ul: How to review your work hours against a payslip

sections.h2: Using Android and Wear OS tools

blocks.p: How the app, home-screen widgets and a watch make it easier to capture time as it happens.
